project.project_title: Licensed Electrical PE (NV) Needed to Review & Stamp Electrical As‑Built Drawings

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Given how simple the project is, I expect the review and stamp to be completed in 2 business days. Since this is a very simple change, I was hoping to have it stamped for \$100. Please let me know. Thanks

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Although the 36 pages may look daunting, you do not actually need to review all of them. I initially thought the same, but the work only involves reviewing the minor modifications identified in the word file. I am a mechanical PE for this change, and my scope was reduced to the attached file \(only the highlighted portion\). The situation is the same for electrical. If it works for you, let’s settle on \$150, and I will notify the client. Please advise.

value_updates.review_extent: Only the minor electrical modifications identified in the Word file and its highlighted portion, rather than all 36 drawing pages
value_updates.primary_review_source: Word file identifying the electrical modifications

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The .pdf file is a copy of the as built drawings, meaning those drawings show the conditions before this project introduced changes. The electrical revisions completed under this project are identified in the word file that you are reviewing and approving so the as built electrical drawings can be amended as part of this project.

value_updates.as_built_drawings_role: Reference drawings showing conditions before the project changes
value_updates.review_purpose: Review and approve the electrical revisions identified in the Word file so the as-built electrical drawings can be amended

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I asked the client to send pictures of the changes so that you can use them to verify that the work was completed as specified in the word file eat.

value_updates.site_photo_purpose: Verify that the completed electrical changes match the specifications in the Word file

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Whichever option is easier for you, you may either stamp the word file and add a cover letter, or mark up the existing pdf with redlines and stamp it to indicate your concurrence with the changes made.

allowed_documentation_methods: stamp the Word file and add a cover letter
mark up the existing PDF with redlines and stamp it

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: I think I’ll stamp the word file and prepare a cover letter confirming that it has been done.

value_updates.selected_documentation_method: stamp the Word file and prepare a cover letter confirming completion

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001],

I hope you’re doing well!

Thank you. We received the client’s electrical notes. The stamped note was good and the drawings were fine; he only wanted specific items called out. I included their request along with the information provided by the electrician. Could you please stamp these callouts? They are part of the original scope, just presented in greater detail.

Thanks

execution.observed_behavior: The downstream client found the stamped note acceptable; the remaining request concerned separate detailed drawing callouts.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Thank you very much for the revision.
However, you are aware that this was not part of our original scope because these are additional stamps.

ambiguity.description: The freelancer disputes the client's assertion that stamping the detailed callouts is included in the original task scope.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Thank you for your response, [FREELANCER_NAME_001]. These callouts contain the same information you stamped in the letter. Rather than appearing as written statements, they are now presented as drawings. You can see that your letter specifies the heading for each callout, while the corresponding description is depicted in the drawing.

Could you please reconsider and stamp the original scope in drawing format? Addressing the city/client’s comments is part of the second milestone.
Thank you in advance for your support.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Additionally, could you let me know whether you can support me with the attached project? Please provide your price and timeline for permit-ready Mechanical, Plumbing and Electrical drawings with an electrical PE stamp \(I will handle the Mechanical and Plumbing stamp\).

source_message.text: My understanding was that the scope only covered review and stamping. Will I also be responsible for providing additional drawings and calculations?
